description: Team Valor announced Oct. 4 that they have decided to skip the Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1) with U. S. S. Valor.

title_en: True Love Takes Prix de la Foret, BC Mile Could Be Next
description: Aidan O'Brien could have sights on the Breeders' Cup Mile (G1T) after True Love's Oct. 4 victory in the Prix de la Foret (G1) at Longchamp.

title_en: Walden Relishes Rhetorical's Second Turf Mile Win
description: Rhetorical returned to Walden's barn at Churchill after the race and will do most of his work there for the Oct. 31 Breeders' Cup Mile (G1) at Keeneland.

title_en: Amusingly Defeats Males in Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere
description: Amusingly put a big smile on the face of her connections after the only filly in the line-up came out on top in the Prix Jean-Luc Lagardere (G1).

title_en: Daryz Goes Back-to-Back in Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
description: On a sweltering afternoon that defied the old trope of damp autumnal Paris, Daryz scythed down the Longchamp straight to obliterate his Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1) rivals Oct. 4 and seize a place in Flat racing's pantheon of all-time greats.

title_en: Baroda Stud Brings Strong Draft to Tattersalls Book 1
description: The consignment features a Frankel colt out of German Oaks heroine (G1) Muskoka; a son of Wootton Bassett and E.P. Taylor Stakes (G1T) scorer Mutamakina, and a Justify filly out of four-time group 1 winner Winter.

title_en: Global Goal Scores Top-Level Win in Flight Stakes
description: Darley's Pinatubo has his first Australian elite winner and Jonathan Munz his latest from his Shoals family after Global Goal took the Flight Stakes (G1) Oct. 3 at Randwick Racecourse.

title_en: Prior Leading Tattersalls' Global Growth, Appeal
description: Tattersalls managing director Matthew Prior is leading the charge as the Newmarket-based auction house continues to grow its appeal with buyers from around the world.

title_en: Victory Achieved Does Just That in Nearctic Stakes
description: Minutes after winning the First Lady Stakes (G1T) at Keeneland with Classic Q, Hall of Fame trainer Mark Casse takes another graded stakes when Live Oak Plantation's Victory Achieved rolls in the Nearctic Stakes (G2T) Oct. 3 at Woodbine.

title_en: Group 1 Winner Fallen Angel Suffers Fatal Injury
description: Karl Burke has paid tribute to his stable star Fallen Angel after she suffered a fatal injury in the Prix Daniel Wildenstein (G2) Oct. 3 at ParisLongchamp Racecourse.

title_en: Godolphin's Arabian Crown Grabs Canadian International
description: Arabian Crown delivers a world-class performance in the 86th running of the $527,334 Canadian International Stakes (G1T) Oct. 3 at Woodbine.

title_en: Domestic Agenda Powers Home in Miss Grillo Stakes
description: After working hard to post a debut win, Klaravich Stables' Domestic Agenda rather easily secured a spot in the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf (G1T) by taking the Miss Grillo Stakes (G2T) by 4 1/2 lengths.

title_en: Hughes Dominates Rivals in American Pharoah Stakes
description: Hughes remains undefeated with an easy, open-length score in the American Pharoah Stakes (G1) Oct. 3 at Santa Anita Park.

title_en: Warming Too Hot to Handle in Dance Smartly
description: Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners' Warming takes the Dance Smartly Stakes (G2T) Oct. 3 at Woodbine.

title_en: Regaled Repeats in Delaware Handicap
description: Ribble Farms, Hoolie Racing Stable, and Kamp Racing Stables' Regaled notches her second consecutive victory in the $600,000 Delaware Handicap (G3) with a win Oct. 3 at Delaware Park.

title_en: Rhetorical Repeats in Keeneland's Turf Mile Stakes
description: After racing comfortably on the lead early, Rhetorical then delivers a strong late run to draw off to an easy victory in the $1,021,406 Turf Mile Stakes (G1T) Oct. 3 at Keeneland, securing victory in the race for a second straight year.

title_en: Let Em Know, Good to Be King Victorious on Belmont Turf
description: Let Em Know made his presence felt by capturing the $250,000 Pilgrim Stakes (G2T) Oct. 3 at Belmont Park, becoming the first graded stakes winner for Spendthrift Farm's freshman sire Jackie's Warrior.

title_en: Dotsy Hands Grabowski Grade 1 Thrill in Frizette
description: One of the reasons why horse racing can be so endearing is because of people like John Grabowski.

title_en: Classic Q Delivers Amazing Win in First Lady
description: The 4-year-old daughter of Classic Empire wins her second grade 1 stakes of the year by a margin of mere inches over 2-1 favorite Lush Lips in the First Lady Stakes (G1T) Oct. 3 at Keeneland. Classic Q now has career earnings just shy of $2 million.

title_en: Domain Expansion Breaks Maiden in Oak Leaf
description: Second in her only prior outing, a 1-mile turf event, Domain Expansion crushed her foes by 7 lengths in the Oak Leaf Stakes (G2) Oct. 3 at Santa Anita Park, earning a berth to the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies (G1).

title_en: American History Rallies to Take Breeders' Futurity
description: Closing relentlessly down the stretch, American History catches favorites Coach Pope and Q B Rocket to win the Oct. 3 Breeders' Futurity (G1) at Keeneland.

title_en: U. S. S. Valor Sails to Easy Champagne Victory
description: Team Valor International's U. S. S. Valor sailed to a dominant 6 1/2-length victory in the $500,000 Champagne Stakes (G1) Oct. 3 at Belmont Park, but connections are hesitant to commit to a trip to the Breeders' Cup Juvenile (G1).

title_en: Ace Stud Lands Arc Entrant Bright Light to Top Arc Sale
description: Ace Stud comes to the fore at the Arqana Arc Sale Oct. 3 when swooping for the two top lots, Bright Light, an entrant in the Oct. 4 Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1), and Space Waltz, each for seven figures.

title_en: Evanescence, Joe Shiesty Capture Grade 2s at Keeneland
description: Evanescence earns an automatic berth in the Breeders' Cup Filly and Mare Sprint (G1) by rallying to take the Oct. 3 Thoroughbred Club of America Stakes (G2) at Keeneland by a neck over Praying.

title_en: Unbeaten Vanta Gets Graded Test in Surfer Girl Stakes
description: In two starts, both wins, 2-year-old filly Vanta has shown signs of a budding star for trainer Jeff Mullins. In the Oct. 4 Surfer Girl Stakes (G3T), Vanta will look to add a second stakes win and a first at the graded level.

title_en: Caballo de Mar Upsets Scandinavia to Repeat in Cadran
description: Caballo de Mar edges away from favored Scandinavia to become the first horse since Westerner in 2004 to secure successive Prix du Cadran (G1) victories Oct. 3 at ParisLongchamp Racecourse.

title_en: Piggybunz Gives Happy Saver His First Stakes Winner
description: Grade 1 winner and first-crop Airdrie Stud stallion Happy Saver was represented by his first black-type winner Oct. 3 when Piggybunz won the $96,000 Smart Halo Stakes at Laurel Park.

title_en: Mystik Dan's Half Brother Mystik Bayou Wins at Belmont
description: Wells Bayou, whose stallion career ended early because of fertility problems, has just one foal: the 2-year-old Mystik Bayou. But acting solo, the juvenile is doing his part to keep his sire in the headlines.

title_en: Skippylongstocking to Stand at New York's Amsterdam Two
description: Skippylongstocking, a 12-time graded stakes winner by Exaggerator, has an initial fee of $3,500, which could change following his performance in the Oct. 31 Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) at Keeneland, according to Amsterdam Two Farm.

title_en: Imagination Retired to Stud at Mountain View Farm
description: Multiple graded stakes-winning millionaire Imagination has been retired and is settling in at Mountain View Farm in New York, where he'll begin his stud career next year.

title_en: Norfolk Winner Shareholder Retired to Tally-Ho Stud
description: 2024 Norfolk Stakes (G2) winner Shareholder has been retired from racing and will stand at Tally-Ho Stud next year.

title_en: Sahlan Retired to Haras de Bouquetot for 2027
description: Sahlan, winner of last year's Prix du Moulin (G1), has retired from racing and will stand at Haras de Bouquetot in Normandy for 2027.

title_en: Kantharos Comes Back to Ocala Stud in Florida for 2027
description: Kantharos returns to Ocala Stud to stand the 2027 breeding season, the farm announced Sept. 30. A stud fee will be announced at a later date.

title_en: Full Agenda Released for Global Symposium on Racing
description: The full agenda for the Annual Global Symposium on Racing is now available at RacingSymposium.com, providing attendees with the complete schedule for the three-day industry event, including session topics, speakers, dates, times, and room locations.

title_en: Candy Ride Success With Storm Cat Repeating With Vekoma
description: Storm Cat-line mares produce first grade 1 winners for Candy Ride and his son Vekoma.

title_en: Major Breeding Operations Raise Money For Injured Rider
description: A host of major breeding operations have rowed in with fundraising efforts to support Kaitlyn Ryan, the 21-year-old amateur jockey who suffered a life-changing spinal cord injury following a freak gallops accident.

title_en: LNJ Foxwoods Co-Founder Larry Roth Dies at 75
description: Larry Roth co-founded Marchon Eyewear that he and his partners sold in 2008. The Roths started LNJ Foxwoods in 2012 and enjoyed tremendous success as both owner and breeder.

title_en: Champion Winx Produces Filly by Too Darn Hot
description: The daughter of Too Darn Hot was born early last week at Coolmore's Hunter Valley and she has already been exploring her new home.

title_en: Leading West Virginia Sire Fiber Sonde Dies at 21
description: Fiber Sonde, an unraced son of Unbridled's Song and a half brother to champion sprinter Speightstown, was West Virginia's general leading sire from 2018-23.

title_en: Belmont Winner Sir Winston Sires First Winner in Canada
description: Belmont Stakes (G1) winner and Crestwood Farm first-crop stallion Sir Winston was represented by his first winner Sept. 27 when West Side Lily won the B Cup 2 Year Olds Stakes in the opening race at Rocky Mountain Turf Club in Lethbridge, Alberta.

title_en: TCA Celebrates Breeder Goodman as Honor Guest
description: Noting his commitment to the Thoroughbred and the land, the Thoroughbred Club of America recognized owner-breeder H. Greg Goodman as its Honor Guest at its 95th testimonial dinner Sept. 26 at Keeneland.

title_en: Washington Owner, Breeder Hagen Dies at Age 81
